task_description: Implement Phase 4 of the generation system spec: Voice Corpus + Document Ingestion. Adds SourceDocument and VoicePassage models, document upload API with CRUD, passage chunking with topic inference, topic-based retrieval, WritingSample migration, and Document Management UI.
